[Prediction](http://Prediction.md):  
Mean first win-episode for budget 1:  
**Literal learner:**  
Oracle\>No-advice\>Selective\>Guess  
**Calibrated learner:**  
Oracle\>Best-Guess\>Selective\>No-Advice	

Disclaimer- I have used AI to get the figures for  this so I could get some intuition on how the selective would differ in updating.
I also triggered a run by accident but stopped in middle and have not seen the results of it.
**![][image1]**  
**The oracle will give the best first win episode for both as it holds the right answers and only fluke could be the probability of misfiring of roles that leads to it playing more episodes.**

**Selective is gonna fare better as if there is a win it is guaranteed that color is correct whereas lethal block can give false claims more easily which can lead to the hot stove effect happening.**  
**Best-Guess is gonna fare better than selective in calibrated learner as it still preserves more information from the trial if prob\<tau rather than just discarding it if it is not confident enough. There would be more false warnings that carry over than selective leading it to performing worse in literal.The hot stove effect will be amplified in the literal learner which would lead to more false avoidance of lethal blocks which are safe and could be the goal for example.**
